mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM `order` WHERE order_status != 'CANCELLED' AND order_date >= #{startDate} AND order_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT oi.product_name AS productName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS totalQuantity, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS totalAmount FROM order_item oi JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_status != 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_date >= #{startDate} AND o.order_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.product_name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(p.category, '未分类') AS category, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS totalAmount FROM order_item oi JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.order_status != 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_date >= #{startDate} AND o.order_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
SELECT product_name AS productName, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity FROM product WHERE status = 1 AND stock_quantity < #{threshold} ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC
SELECT order_no AS orderNo, customer_name AS customerName, total_amount AS totalAmount, order_status AS orderStatus, order_date AS orderDate FROM `order` ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeProducts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inactiveProducts FROM product
SELECT customer_name AS customerName, phone, create_time AS createTime FROM customer ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
